title: Aluminum parts, fabrication for transportation frame
description_text: Contractors must be certified through Defense Logistics Information Services (DLIS) Joint Certification Program in order to access Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) or Export Controlled information in Contract Opportunities. See the DLA website for the Joint Certification Program: https://www.dla.mil/HQ/LogisticsOperations/Services/JCP/. The Naval Research Laboratorys Tactical Electronic Warfare Division, Code 5700, has a requirement for the procurement of Aluminum parts, fabrication for transportation frame For additional details on the submission of quotes, please see the attached Combined Synopsis/Solicitation N00173-26-Q-1301357113A1 and Attachment 2  Drawings, which is issued in accordance with FAR Subparts 13.5 and 12.6.
